# Loverball

> Loverball brings together events, members, stories, and culture for women sports fans.

Loverball is a Los Angeles–rooted, women-led sports community covering the WNBA, NWSL, NCAA women's basketball, and broader women's sports culture. Members discover events, follow favorite teams, connect with other fans, and read curated sports news.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, mission, and member access.
- [Feed](/feed): Immersive video and content feed for women's sports.
- [Events / Scene](/events): Upcoming watch parties, meetups, and cultural events.
- [Club / Members](/members): Member directory and friend search.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, All Access, and The Club membership tiers.
- [Sign up](/signup): Join with an invite code.
- [Sign in](/auth): Member login.
